# Hari Krishnan R | Portfolio

> Creative developer portfolio showcasing projects in web, algorithms, and interactive art. Computer Science undergraduate at Government Engineering College, Thrissur, based in Kerala, India.

## Key topics

- Projects: compilers, systems programming, neural networks, web apps, games
- Experience: internships at Auvieo, 10xMinds, Oracle
- Skills: Python, C, Rust, TypeScript; React, SvelteKit, Node.js, Tailwind; PostgreSQL, Firestore; Docker, Podman; Flutter, Tauri
